model_details.name: PERUNDHU Madurai Pilot Corridor ETA Predictor

intended_use.primary_intended_uses: Real-time estimated arrival time (ETA) prediction for passenger bus tracking in Madurai pilot corridors (Routes 70, 77).
intended_use.primary_intended_users: PERUNDHU passenger tracking application and TNSTC transit dispatchers.
intended_use.out_of_scope_uses: Not intended for emergency response routing, traffic signal preemption, or statewide non-surveyed corridors without validation.

data_readiness_and_limitations.hardware_gap_disclosure: Physical ETM/GPS units in production are undergoing staged hardware rollout. Continuous multi-month physical historical GPS is currently being accumulated. Production fallback to baseline model is active.
data_readiness_and_limitations.environmental_conditions: Predictions degrade if bus deviates significantly (>150m) from route polyline or GPS telemetry exceeds 120s age.
